scientific_integrity: A mathematical proof for the infinite tail and complete exact finite-type recurrence are included. Two separately implemented boundary checks agree; finite tests are not used as infinite proof. No independent review or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the finite single-crown strict-order family at quantifier rank four; finite boundary \(2\le n\le12\) verified exactly and infinite tail independently proved using a stronger cyclic expansion. Historical priority is not conclusively resolved; no external mathematical audit.
title: Six rank-four theories of finite crown posets
